info.name: Gantara Mail setup
info.summary: Lets the Gantara portal add a customer's Gantara Mail mailbox to their Nextcloud Mail app
info.description: An admin-only OCS API for the gantara-portal. When a customer sets their mailbox password in the Gantara dashboard, the portal passes it through once and this app creates (or updates) the account in that user's Nextcloud Mail, with the Gantara Mail servers, through Mail's own services. It removes the account again when the mailbox is deleted or handed to someone else. The servers come from this app's config, never from the request. Gantara enables it on the shared instance only (k8s-platform-ovh docs/gantara-mail.md, "Nextcloud Mail on the shared instance").
info.author: Dunetrails
